# @metator/testing

## Responsibility

Fakes for every port, port contract suites and shared fixtures (the Bun-workspaces monorepo) used by unit and e2e tests.

## Invariants

- Adapters prove they honor a port by running its contract suite [[cite: packages/testing/src/contracts/file-system.contract.ts:10 | "export function fileSystemContract(name: string, make: FileSystemFactory): void {"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` only. Production code never imports it.

## Pitfalls

- A fake that is more lenient than the real adapter hides bugs; when an adapter test finds a difference, fix the fake too.
